status_note: These tolerances are a maintainer-reviewable draft, not scientifically approved values. They define what benchmark/bench_regression.py treats as a material change; revise by PR.
rule: A metric fails when its increase (candidate - previous; |MBE| for bias) exceeds max(floor, relative * previous). Only full-period statistics are gated; seasonal and window breakdowns stay descriptive (bench_drift.py).
provenance: Calibrated on 2026-09-07 against the recorded release history under results/ (2025.7.6 .. 2026.6.5): energy-balance MAE moved by at most 0.03 W m^-2 between consecutive releases; the RSL 6.5 m air-temperature MAE moved by +0.12 K at 2026.1.28 -> 2026.4.3, which exceeds the RSL tolerance and is carried under 'accepted' with its reason. The 0.05 floors match the display band on the benchmark page.
rationale: Passing the recorded history is a consistency requirement for the CI sweep, not evidence that these tolerances detect every scientifically meaningful regression. A candidate release is judged by check_regression.py --candidate against its predecessor; a pass under these values means 'within the draft tolerance', not 'no regression'.

accepted.reason: RSL profile physics changed in this release cycle (c2m/c2h computed from HF08 RSL theory, PR #1116); the 6.5 m air-temperature MAE shift of +0.12 K shipped with 2026.4.3 and is recorded on the benchmark page.
